balancing_approach: Greedy balanced: sort symbols by min centroid distance (most certain first), assign to nearest cluster under exact target sizes [base + (1 if i < remainder else 0)]. 10/K=3 -> [4,3,3], guaranteed min >= 3
lone_cluster_routing: Not needed - balanced assignment guarantees min cluster = n_symbols // k = 3 for 10/K=3
notes_for_reviewer: Integer arithmetic used instead of round() to avoid bankers rounding
